requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:34-63 implements send/no-op/POST/5s timeout/1800-char multibyte cut; :66-82 redacts sensitive keys, Bearer strings and nested arrays; :53-63 soft-fails on non-2xx and transport exceptions while scrubbing the URL. config/logging.php:57 sets the stack default to daily and :76-82 adds the audit channel; config/services.php:38-40 adds services.discord.webhook_url; .env.example:19-28 adds all five env keys; docs/ops/logging.md:1-57 documents the three lanes; phpunit.xml:29-30 pins the test log stack.

conventions.evidence: Every new behavior ships with a Pest test (tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:43-164, tests/Feature/Ops/LoggingConfigTest.php:5-44); docs are updated in the same change (docs/ops/logging.md, docs/ops/devops.md, CHANGELOG.md); send() has a PHPDoc block (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:27-33); the task-mandated App\Ops class is used instead of an extra service layer, and there is no Livewire/auth surface to which the security policy applies.

security.evidence: Sensitive-key regex and Bearer scrub are applied to context values and recursively to nested arrays (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:23-25,68-87); the catch path scrubs the webhook URL before logging (:54); tests assert that secrets and the token never appear in the payload or logs (tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:92-164). No user input, authorization boundary, or unescaped output is introduced.

tests.evidence: Strong coverage of no-op, exact URL/body, context formatting, booleans/null, 1800-character truncation, all redaction rules, non-2xx and transport failures (tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:43-164), plus stack/audit/daily/no-discord config tests and an audit write-level test (tests/Feature/Ops/LoggingConfigTest.php:5-44). The new config tests are not fully hermetic because they assert env-backed defaults that phpunit.xml does not pin.

simplicity.evidence: One class with no constructor and one public method (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:17-103); it reuses blank(), Http, Log, mb_substr and json_encode and adds no dependencies or speculative abstractions.

readability.evidence: Clear constants and small focused helpers (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:19-25,66-102), useful docblocks (:10-16,27-33), and descriptive test names; only minor formatting/organization nits were found.

scope.evidence: The diff is limited to the notifier, config/services.php, config/logging.php, .env.example, phpunit.xml, tests, and docs/CHANGELOG. It does not wire the notifier into jobs or handlers and does not add retries, embeds, rate limiting, or external log shipping, matching task.md's out-of-scope list.

issues.explanation: The config tests assert env-backed defaults (days 14/90, level info), but phpunit.xml only pins LOG_STACK and DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL; a local .env created from the updated .env.example sets LOG_DAILY_DAYS/LOG_AUDIT_* (as strings or customized values), so the suite can fail and the documented claim that it does not depend on a local .env is not true. Pin these keys in phpunit.xml or make the assertions hermetic.

The transport-exception test only checks the log message and the absence of the token; it does not assert the error/exception context, so a regression that logged a status or dropped the exception details from the catch path could still pass.

The test file declares a global constant and two global helper functions; Pest loads test files in the same process, so these names can collide with other test files. Prefer helpers in tests/Pest.php or methods on a test class.
The inserted blank line after the new Changed bullet splits the list; removing it keeps the changelog consistent with the surrounding Keep a Changelog formatting.

review.summary: The change adds a well-scoped DiscordOpsAlert service with no-op, redaction, truncation and soft-fail behavior, plus the daily/audit logging configuration, env keys, documentation and tests. It meets the task and the project conventions; the main follow-up is making the new config tests hermetic by pinning the new log env keys, with a few small test and changelog nits.
